notes: The opening «ما كان فيه عن أبي الأعز النخاس» names the source of the whole section; the first route's chain stops at صفوان بن يحيى in this text, so Abu al-Azz is not appended to it.
«أبي» is the compiler's father, named only by relation: a relation link. «رضي الله عنه» is a blessing, left out.
Diacritics are left out of the surfaces.
